name: Helleborine
source:
A toxic yuri kinetic visual novel about two women's meetings at their local library on Sundays and what brought them there. 

[Edited from [url=https://tabbiedearest.itch.io/helleborine]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部有毒的尤里动感视觉小说，讲述了两名妇女周日在当地图书馆举行的会议以及是什么让她们来到这里的。

[编辑自[url=https://tabbiedearest.itch.io/helleborine]itch.io[/url]]
